thread.title: Stock Market Update: Cyclicals Lead S&P 500 Higher

title: Stock Market Update: Cyclicals Lead S&P 500 Higher
text:
Cyclicals Lead S&P 500 Higher 01-Nov-18 13:00 ET Dow +229.50 at 25345.26, Nasdaq +99.23 at 7405.32, S&P +22.86 at 2734.74
[BRIEFING.COM] The S&P 500 has extended its rally to its third day, up 0.8%, as the benchmark index gets some help from the cyclical sectors. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 0.9%, the Nasdaq Composite is up 1.2%, and the Russell 2000 outperforms with a gain of 1.5%.
Stocks reacted kindly to a tweet from U.S. President Trump this morning, stating that he had a long and very good conversation with Chinese President Xi. He added that
Likewise, today's strong-performing sectors include the materials (+2.8%), industrial (+1.6%), and consumer discretionary (+1.5%) groups. The lightly-weighted materials sector has surged largely due to its top-weighted component DowDuPont (DWDP 57.52, +3.58, +6.6%) reporting better-than-expected earnings.
In addition, chipmakers have continued to put on a strong showing, as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rises 3.6%. Chip stocks have provided some steady support for the information technology sector, which is only up 0.5%. Since its Monday's close, the index has rallied nearly 10%. Notable chipmaker Advanced Micro (AMD 19.63, +1.40) has spiked 7.7%.
Conversely, the communication services sector has backpedaled from its strong performance yesterday with a loss of 0.1%. Also, the utilities sector underperforms the broader market, down 0.7%.
Separately, with equities rising, Treasuries have risen slightly with Apple 's (AAPL 219.18, +0.32, +0.2%) earnings and Friday's Employment Situation Report on tap. The 2-yr yield is down three basis points to 2.85%, and the 10-yr yield is down one basis point to 3.14%.
